title: PFAS surveillance within a highly militarized island: a case study of Okinawa, Japan
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00508B, Communication
Camden G. Camacho, Kaylie Anne Costa, Shannon McMahon, Jeffrey Jolly, Timothy Ravasi, Joe Aufmuth, John A. Bowden
Comprehensive monitoring of 31 PFAS on a highly militarized island. ∑PFAS measured for 15 individual PFAS analogues. Varying PFAS fingerprints found at different geographical locations on the island.
